entities.title: Hivestorm
entities.summary: A formation-and-dive arcade shooter for the browser: one player, or two online taking turns, each on their own device, with a replay-checked high-score table.
entities.purpose: Holds the whole game: the browser game in src/, the Worker that serves it and keeps the high-score table in worker/, the page in public/, and the tests in test/. It is one npm project and one Cloudflare Worker.
boundaries: Online games are relayed by the games hub, which lives in another repository; this folder only connects to it.
The sign-in is icelander.net's; the Worker checks it with the shared library in vendor/icelander-auth/, never edited here.
